Any external system using it will lose access immediately.')) return await api.post(`/admin/api-tokens/${id}/revoke`) toast.success('Token revoked') load() } const remove = async (id: number) => { if (!window.confirm('Delete this token row permanently?')) return await api.delete(`/admin/api-tokens/${id}`) toast.success('Token deleted') load() } return (
